setlist_extra.title: SGT. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band/Crowd/Tuning

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Doll** (4 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer rates this China Doll and the jam after it as their favorite, though similar versions exist; Reviewer's favorite China Doll ever [5][30][31][32][37]
- **Keep On Growing** (3 reviews): The band stumbles somewhat in this song; The guitar solo in this song is a favorite moment for the reviewer [29][33][36]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Dew into Playin' at the start of set two is a standout of an uneven performance; Played with great power; reviewer has heard no other version like it and recommends playing it loud [29][37]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer considers it a good opener [38]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 other source): Returned to the setlist after a three-year absence [3]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer counts the Playin' among the show's other great selections [37]
- **Jam (Brent w/drummers)** (1 review): Brent's short jam with the drummers after China Doll is singled out as enjoyable [31]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sgt. Pepper's / Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [41]
- **Keep On Growing**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [41]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-06-14.148769.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 176 min [1]
- **gd1985-06-14.matrix.chappell.85831.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 155 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Jerry sits low in the mix for most of the show, slightly more so on the matrix [3]
- **gd85-06-14.oade-schoeps.sacks.24451.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1985-06-14.152788.OTSNAK300-SGMasterCassetteAnonNoelt-flac1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd85-06-14.sbd.carman.13747.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 148 min; rated 4.42/5 by 24 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is solid, with good levels and almost no hiss; slight digital noise appears in the right channel during Dew; Reviewer feels the drums are too loud in the mix [29][38]
- **gd85-06-14.oade.sacks.4978.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 146 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [22]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this Oade recording a great one; Reviewer finds the Oade recording very good [31][32]

## Around the show

- Friday evening show at the Greek, overlooking Berkeley, the bay and the bridge, with a crowd under 20,000 [35]
- Equipment problems hit the first set; the band took a short break, then returned [36]
- There was an equipment break after Hell In A Bucket [1]
- Technical issues in set one forced a mid-set break; the band returned and played Keep On Growing [3]
- Equipment broke down after Hell in a Bucket [5]
- Reviewer rejects the idea that this is the best China Doll ever [38]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-06-14.148769.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (135 degrees, x/y pattern, mounted on pole 7' high)(12 rows up from walkway, behind soundboard) >… [1]. Also: A 7-second patch in Drums comes from the Oade Schoeps source [1]
- **gd1985-06-14.matrix.chappell.85831.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info files for details; transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix: (SBD/AUD mix) See info file for details [3]
- **gd85-06-14.oade-schoeps.sacks.24451.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Doug Oade - Darren Sacks; source: Field: Schoeps cmc42S (spread around 8') > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1 [4]. Also: Recorded by the Oade Brothers with Schoeps microphones spread about eight feet, into Oade M118 preamps and a modified Sony PCM-F1 [4]
- **gd1985-06-14.152788.OTSNAK300-SGMasterCassetteAnonNoelt-flac1648**: taped by Recorded, Transferred & Mastered by Anon; transferred by Edited & add'l Mastering in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel January 26, 2021; source: Source: Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Master Cassette (Maxell MX90s, Dolby B On) Location: Taper section; stand 6 to 7 feet high. [5]. Also: Anonymous master cassettes, pitch corrected, with tape flips crossfaded and a patch from the Oade source [5]
- **gd85-06-14.sbd.carman.13747.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR/? [7]
- **gd85-06-14.oade.sacks.4978.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps cmc42S (spread around 8') > Oade M118 prototype "b" > Oade Modified PCM-F1 > DATx2 (44.1khz) Recorded by Doug Oade, Taper's Section [22]
